# Retry & Error Handling

Reference file for [citations.md](../citations.md).

## Retry Mechanisms

Windmill provides two retry modes, configurable per step [11]:

### Constant Retry

Fixed delay between attempts. Configure via Advanced menu → Retries [11]:
- Maximum attempts
- Delay (seconds, minutes, hours, or days)

### Exponential Backoff

Formula: `delay = multiplier × base^(attempt number)` [11]

Parameters:
- Base (in seconds)
- Multiplier
- Maximum attempts

Example (base=3, multiplier=2, 5 attempts) [11]:

| Attempt | Delay |
|---------|-------|
| 1 | 6s |
| 2 | 18s |
| 3 | 54s |
| 4 | 162s |
| 5 | 486s |

### Combined Retries

If both constant and exponential are defined, constant retries are tried
first, then exponential [11].

## Error Handling Methods

Four approaches available [37]:

| Method | Behavior | Source |
|--------|----------|--------|
| Retries | Re-execute failed step with constant or exponential delay | [11] |
| Error handlers | Execute a special script/flow on error | [38] |
| Early stop | Stop flow after all retries exhausted | [37] |
| Break | Continue to next step after retries fail | [37] |

### Error Handler Steps

Error handler steps receive the failed step's result with the error in the
`error` field [38]. Common use cases:
- Slack/Teams/Discord notifications
- Logging to external systems
- Cleanup operations

### Continue on Error

When enabled, flows proceed to the next step even after all retries fail.
This allows building error processing branches downstream [11]. Default
behavior is "Stop on error and propagate error up" [11].

## Worker Behavior During Retries

Steps retry until success or max retries reached. The worker is occupied
during retry attempts. After all retries fail, the error handler is
called [11][38].

## Comparison to n8n

| Aspect | Windmill | n8n |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Retry modes | Constant + exponential | Node-level retry |
| Backoff formula | Configurable base/multiplier | Auto exponential |
| Error handler | Dedicated step type | Error Trigger workflow |
| Continue on error | Per-step toggle | Per-node toggle |
| Dead letter queue | No (use error handlers) | No |

## Gaps and Limitations

- Maximum retry attempts limit (if any hard cap) not documented [11]
- No built-in dead letter queue integration (DLQ behavior must be
  implemented via error handler scripts)
- Error handler configuration for schedules is Enterprise-only [8]
- No documented rate limiting for retries (e.g., preventing thundering
  herd on retried API calls)
- Retry configuration is UI-based; programmatic configuration via API
  not detailed in docs
